Definition / Rule: Single-player PvE deckbuilding RPG card game inspired by MTG. No direct interaction: everything (Tools, Wonders, resources, unit abilities) is used only on your own turn. Only Traps act on the opponent's turn, and only when their specific condition is met.
Notes: Light-hearted, deep mechanics. Humor is extremely important: puns, references, and nods millennials will get.

Definition / Rule: 45-card minimum including ~19 Infrastructure. Up to 4 copies of each non-Infrastructure card. 2 Paths max during the main game; all Paths after beating the final boss.
Notes: Player HP: 10 at level 1, up to 25 at max level. Keep face damage modest.

EXHAUST = tap: the card is spent until it refreshes at the start of its controller's turn. REFRESH = untap. ACTIVATE = the act of using any ability (rules/UI term only; never written as a cost). Abilities list only their real costs: "Exhaust, pay 1: ..." taps the card; "Use 3 Red Tape: ..." does not.
Notes: Replaces the earlier Activate = tap rule.

Aggressive, chaotic. Hustle, big strong units, raw stat boosts, Tools/equipment, tempo, direct damage to units and face, throwing and portal tricks. Burst now, pay later.
Notes: Preferred type: Tool. Minimal: Traps. Opposes Necrocrats.

Definition / Rule: Orderly, value-grinding. Small tokens (zombies, skeletons) to go wide, reanimator, profit from deaths, drain, delayed but inevitable effects, taxes and fees, Red Tape/Contract control.
Notes: Preferred type: Spell. Minimal: Wonders. Opposes Beefcakes.

Definition / Rule: Refined, controlling, defensive artificers. Chefs (small units) and Wonders that turn Ingredients into big Golem tokens; recipes (card selection/draw), healing, bounce and transformation removal.
Notes: Preferred type: Wonder. Minimal: Spells. Opposes Refusemancers.

Definition / Rule: Resilient, recycling growth. Garbage-eating units with direct effects, ramp into big units, Refuse Pile as a resource, scrappy animals (rats), Tool/Wonder/resource destruction.
Notes: Preferred type: Trap. Minimal: Tools. Opposes Gourmands.

Definition / Rule: Primary: direct damage (units or face), Yeet. Mass: damage to all units. Strong vs: small/mid units, Tools (smash). Weak vs: high-defense units, Wonders.

Primary: send back, Plate, eat units for Ingredients. Mass: send back all units. Strong vs: big threats and tokens, Tools (dismantle). Weak vs: repeated threats, recursion.

Primary: Brawl, Eat Garbage damage, traps on entering units, big units eating things. Mass: destroy all Tools/Wonders. Strong vs: Tools, Wonders, resources, Flying (Swat). Weak vs: Untouchable/Elusive units.

2 damage for 1 energy; 3-4 damage for 2-3; targeted destroy 3-4; mass removal 4-6. Face damage costs more than unit damage.

Notes: Your turn only (no need to say it on each card).
